heroHeadline: De la Espriella Escalates Offensive on Clan del Golfo After 148-Arrest Sweep
heroSubtitle: Police and prosecutors arrested 148 people in Operation Perla on October 1, with five suspects killed. President de la Espriella threatened Clan del Golfo leaders 'Felipe' and 'Sebastián' with an 'expiration date', while a FARC-dissident drone attack killed a soldier in Huila. He also reversed a planned October gasoline price hike.
footerNote: Data sourced from the Colombian Truth Commission (CEV), JEP, INDEPAZ, InSight Crime, ICRC, Human Rights Watch, UNODC, MOE (Electoral Observation Mission), Ecopetrol, Registraduría Nacional, and major international outlets.
